en-US.author: https://github.com/pbek
en-US.description: QOwnNotes is the open source notepad with markdown support and todo list manager
en-US.name: QOwnNotes
en-US.releaseNotes:
26.10.15
- Extended the search field in the local and Nextcloud / ownCloud note trash dialogs
  to search note text as well as note names, ignoring case
  (for #3823)
  - Selecting a match shows its note text; clearing the search shows all trashed notes again
  - The in-note search bar opens with the same query to highlight and navigate text matches
- Retired the legacy Qt 5-named Snap jobs from stable and continuous GitHub releases
  (for #3752)
  - Use the Qt 6 snap from the Snap Store
  - The final genuine Qt 5 AMD64 snap, QOwnNotes-Qt5-amd64.snap, remains available
    in the 26.10.6 release
  - Later artifacts with that filename already used Qt 6; Qt 5 macOS builds and
    source compatibility remain supported for now
- Added an editor setting Do not insert a space after autocompletion to suppress the
  trailing space for script and language server completions
  (for #3781,
  #3819, thank you, @sciurius)
- Added case-insensitive text search across all loaded versions in the Nextcloud / ownCloud
  and Git note version dialogs (for #3822)
  - The search field above the version list filters versions by their note text
  - Matches are highlighted with the regular search bar in the Note text tab
- There was a new release of QOwnNotes for Android,
  v1.8.0
  - Search text across all note versions in the note versions dialog, filtering the list to
    matching versions with match counts and highlighted excerpts
  - The version preview highlights all matches and lets you step between them
Released files
- QOwnNotes-x86_64.AppImage: Portable Linux AppImage build with Qt 6
- QOwnNotes-x86_64.AppImage.sha256sum: SHA-256 checksum for the AppImage
- QOwnNotes-amd64.snap: Linux Snap build with Qt 6
- QOwnNotes-amd64.snap.sha256sum: SHA-256 checksum for the Qt 6 Snap package
- QOwnNotes.zip: Windows ZIP package built with Qt 6
- QOwnNotes.zip.sha256: SHA-256 checksum for the Qt 6 Windows ZIP package
- QOwnNotes.zip.sha256sum: Alternative SHA-256 checksum file for the Qt 6 Windows ZIP package
- QOwnNotes.msi: Windows installer built with Qt 6
- QOwnNotes.msi.sha256sum: SHA-256 checksum for the Qt 6 Windows installer
- QOwnNotes.dmg: macOS disk image built with Qt 6
- QOwnNotesQt5.dmg: macOS disk image built with Qt 5 for older systems
